versions.content: Service Name Icu_ Get Duty Cycle Values Syntax void Icu_ Get Duty Cycle Values ( Icu_ Channel Type Channel, Icu_ Duty Cycle Type* Duty Cycle Values ) Service ID [hex] 0x11 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant (limited according to ICU050) Parameters (in) Channel Numeric identifier of the ICU channel Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) Duty Cycle Values Pointer to a buffer where the results (high time and period time) shall be placed. Return value None Description This function reads the coherent active time and period time for the given ICU Channel. Available via Icu.h
